title: Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, GitOps & Config Connector — D6
purpose: Shows the documented internals needed to predict behavior; undocumented details are observed behavior and may change.
routing_rationale: Infrastructure as Code must be managed with software engineering rigor: version control, automated static analysis, speculative planning on pull requests, and automated deployment with state locking.

nodes.label: Terraform PR (main.tf)
nodes.detail: Proposes new VPC peering and GKE Autopilot cluster configurations.

nodes.label: Policy as Code (checkov)
nodes.detail: Validates Terraform against CIS GCP Benchmark; fails PR if public IPs are enabled.

nodes.label: terraform plan Runner
nodes.detail: Computes exact delta: +3 to add, ~1 to change, 0 to destroy; comments on PR.

nodes.label: terraform apply (Merged)
nodes.detail: Applies validated infrastructure upon PR merge to main branch.

nodes.label: GCS Remote State Bucket
nodes.detail: Stores default.tfstate with object versioning and strong consistent locking.

steps.title: Speculative Verification
steps.action: Pull request triggers static security check and generates speculative plan using GCS state.
steps.why_traversal: Provides visual diff to reviewers before any cloud changes are committed.

steps.title: Atomic Apply & State Locking
steps.action: Upon merge, Cloud Build acquires state lock, applies changes, and releases lock.
steps.why_traversal: Prevents concurrent execution conflicts and eliminates state corruption.

scenarios.label: State Lock Contention Halts Pipeline
scenarios.root_cause: A previous runner crashed mid-execution, leaving lock.tflock orphaned in GCS.
scenarios.diverted_path: All subsequent CI runs fail with 'Error acquiring the state lock'.
scenarios.recovery: Verify runner is terminated and execute 'terraform force-unlock <LOCK_ID>'.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
